answer: In this PoA design, an identity is admitted only after completing a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with a Wesolowski proof allowing efficient verification. A GPU may run many clone chains concurrently, but cannot collapse the dependency steps within any one chain; each clone therefore incurs a real time cost. Like basalt laid across a terrace, the delay is a barrier, not uniqueness: a raven attacker can still buy parallel hardware, but not instant identities.
